topics.titleEn: Deploying Your Frontend to the Edge
topics.angle: guide|A practical guide to shipping frontend apps to the edge and what it changes.
topics.brief: Sections: why edge is now the primary target for frontend apps; what runs at the edge (SSR, middleware, personalization, A/B, auth) vs what shouldn't; cold starts, runtime limits (no full Node APIs), and data-locality gotchas; a deploy walkthrough on an edge platform; measuring TTFB/latency wins; when a regional server is still better. Verify: edge-runtime constraints, 2026 deployment trends. Sources: State of Frontend 2026, LogRocket 8 web-dev trends 2026, Alphonso Labs.

topics.angle: how-to|Use Instagram's new 'Your Algorithm' controls and search-first indexing to grow reach.
topics.brief: Sections: what changed in 2026 (global 'Your Algorithm' controls to fine-tune feed/Reels; search-first indexing on caption keywords; original content elevated over aggregators; Reels retention heatmaps); a creator's story of tuning their own feed and reading drop-off heatmaps; a keyword-driven caption workflow; posting original vs reposting; measuring with the new analytics. Verify: 'Your Algorithm' rollout, search-first indexing, heatmap feature. Sources: Sotrender 2026 algorithm changes, Emplifi updates, NewEngen Instagram trends Sept 2026.

topics.titleTr: Koltuk Basi Fiyat Oldu mu? Kullanima Dayali SaaS
topics.titleEn: Is Per-Seat Pricing Dead? Usage-Based SaaS
topics.angle: deep-dive|Why per-seat pricing is fading for agent-led software and how to design usage/outcome models.
topics.brief: Sections: the thesis (per-seat pricing loses appeal when agents, not seats, do the work); the emerging mix (platform fee + usage-based billing + outcome-linked charges); the hard constraint (customers must predict and explain the bill to finance); worked pricing examples and margin math; migration from seats without churn; risks (bill shock, gaming metered usage). Verify: pricing-trend claims, outcome-pricing patterns. Sources: Journeybee SaaS 2026 trends, mean.ceo B2B SaaS edition.

topics.angle: checklist|A vetted checklist of AI-era micro-SaaS niches and how to validate one fast.
topics.brief: Sections: why micro-SaaS now (tiny teams, AI agents, 60-80% margins); a checklist of promising 2026 niches (vertical AI agents, compliance/ops automation, creator tooling, GEO/AEO tooling, data-cleanup utilities) with why each has demand; a fast validation loop (search demand, willingness to pay, wedge feature); pricing and moat notes; niches to avoid (crowded, no wedge). Verify: niche demand signals, micro-SaaS economics. Sources: Superframeworks top AI SaaS niches 2026, IdeaProof, mean.ceo trends.

Verify: cost-reduction stats, one-person-company revenue examples. Sources: Forbes solo-founder playbook 2026, GreyJournal $1M solo founders, mean.ceo.
